page_title: MP4Flow — Free MP4 Video Converter for Mac

sources.entry: MP4Flow - Native FFmpeg front end for batch video-to-MP4 conversion, trimming, cropping, rotating, and merging. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/ixiehao/MP4Flow) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: MP4Flow
summary.one_liner: A free, open-source, lightweight native macOS app that batch-converts MOV, MKV, AVI and WMV videos to MP4 locally, using FFmpeg installed separately.
use_cases: Convert MOV, MKV, AVI or WMV clips to MP4 on a Mac
Batch convert a folder of videos
Trim, crop or rotate a video without uploading it
Merge several clips in queue order
Shrink video file size to an approximate target
summary.what_it_does: MP4Flow is a macOS app that converts common MOV, MKV, AVI and WMV videos to MP4, either singly or in batches. Smart Convert can copy compatible video streams without re-encoding and uses hardware acceleration when available. Editing features include trimming by dragging a range or entering exact times, cropping edges, rotating by 90 or 180 degrees, and correcting aspect ratio with presets or a custom ratio. It can also merge unedited clips in queue order, lift dark scenes, add light denoise, set an approximate target size, choose audio tracks, and keep or burn in text subtitles. Processing happens locally with no account or upload, and the queue and settings persist between launches.
notable: Native FFmpeg front end with about 3 MB download
Smart Convert copies compatible video without re-encoding
Local processing with no uploads or account
Open source; requires separately installed FFmpeg and ffprobe
caveats: Requires macOS 13 or later and separately installed FFmpeg and ffprobe
Target size is an estimate and compression can reduce quality
Light denoise may soften fine detail; re-encodes SDR video only
